node.statement: Let e_1 be the first standard basis column of C^n and define the canonical square zero-paddings X_c:=X e_1^* in M_n tensor S_{P,Q} and X_r:=e_1 X^dagger=X_c^dagger in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}. Thus X_c has X as its first column and zero other columns, while X_r has X^dagger as its first row and zero other rows.
